MDLive.name: MDLive
MDLive.description: A Markdown previewer that re-renders the moment the file changes on disk. Native macOS app (Swift, WKWebView) plus a Linux port (GTK3, WebKit2GTK) sharing the same renderer.

supercaffeinate.name: supercaffeinate
supercaffeinate.description: Keep a Mac fully awake from the terminal or a menu bar item: no sleep, no display sleep, no screensaver, no auto-lock, with sensible lid and external display handling.
